repository.name: @webex/plugin-authorization-node
repository.purpose: Node authorization plugin registered as webex.authorization for Node builds (re-exported by the @webex/plugin-authorization Node entry, which webex-node and webex require, and imported directly by @webex/webex-server). It exchanges an OAuth authorization code at the identity broker token endpoint with the confidential client id and secret and maps HTTP 400 responses to grant errors, exchanges a host JWT for an access token through hydra jwt/login, mints HS256 guest JWTs, and posts a logout request without awaiting it. It performs no CSRF or state check and stores no tokens itself.

external_deps: live Webex services (identity broker token endpoint, hydra jwt/login)

authorization-node-sdk.summary: Published npm package. main is dist/index.js and devMain is src/index.js. Importing it imports @webex/internal-plugin-device and registers Authorization as public plugin 'authorization' with proxies isAuthorizing and isAuthenticating and the empty credentials config from src/config.js; the first registration of the name wins. Exports are the default Authorization class and the named config. The plugin API on webex.authorization is requestAuthorizationCodeGrant, requestAccessTokenFromJwt, createJwt, and logout, plus the isAuthorizing, isAuthenticating, and inherited ready properties. Per-method behavior is in src/docs/README.md.

idbroker-token-endpoint.source: Identity broker token endpoint (credentials tokenUrl, derived from idbroker.url or TOKEN_URL in webex-core credentials config; route definitions are not in this repository)
idbroker-token-endpoint.summary: POST urlencoded form {grant_type: authorization_code, redirect_uri, code, self_contained_token: true} with HTTP Basic client_id and client_secret. The response body is stored as the supertoken; an HTTP 400 body carries the OAuth error, error_description, and error_uri.

idbroker-logout-endpoint.source: Identity broker logout endpoint (credentials logoutUrl, derived from idbroker.url in webex-core credentials config; route definitions are not in this repository)
idbroker-logout-endpoint.summary: POST JSON body {token, cisService}; token comes from WebexCore#logout and cisService from the undeclared credentials key service. The response is not observed.

hydra-jwt-login.source: Hydra jwt/login (reached as service name 'hydra' through the services catalog, else HYDRA_SERVICE_URL, else https://api.ciscospark.com/v1/; route definitions are not in this repository)
hydra-jwt-login.summary: POST <hydra>jwt/login with the JWT in the authorization header returns {token, expiresIn}, mapped to a Bearer supertoken.

webex-core-plugin-host.summary: Authorization extends WebexPlugin in namespace Credentials (inheriting ready true), is registered with registerPlugin (first-wins, proxies supported), sends requests with this.webex.request, and is called last by WebexCore#logout with token defaulted from the supertoken; WebexCore#logout chains on the return value, which is undefined, so the logout request is not awaited.

webex-core-credentials.summary: The credentials config supplies tokenUrl, logoutUrl, client_id, client_secret, and redirect_uri; credentials.set({supertoken}) stores tokens; grantErrors.select maps OAuth error strings with an OAuthError fallback; in JWT mode refresh() calls jwtRefreshCallback and then this plugin's requestAccessTokenFromJwt.

webex-core-services.summary: get('hydra', true) supplies the hydra URL; initServiceCatalogs() runs after a JWT exchange.

http-core-request-transport.source: @webex/http-core request (reached through webex.request; module spec consulted: packages/@webex/http-core/src/request/docs/README.md)
http-core-request-transport.summary: The Node transport hands the options to the request library, which serializes form as urlencoded and builds Basic auth from auth; json true is the default for the logout body.

webex-common-utilities.summary: oneFlight (keyed by method name) decorates requestAuthorizationCodeGrant and requestAccessTokenFromJwt; whileInFlight('isAuthorizing') decorates requestAuthorizationCodeGrant.

internal-plugin-device-registration.summary: Imported by src/index.js only for its side effect of registering internal plugin 'device' and its onBeforeLogout unregister hook.

jsonwebtoken.summary: jwt.sign(payload, secret, {expiresIn}) produces the HS256 guest JWT; an undefined expiresIn option is rejected.

uuid.summary: The default export generates the guest subject and default display name.
